title: The Bird and the Girl
note: b384 — first use of the generic 'child' prop.

pages.brief: Pip drawn small and neat on a park railing, seen against a big open park background so his smallness reads. Fresh greens.
pages.alt: Pip is drawn small and neat on a park railing, seen against a big open park background so his smallness reads.

pages.brief: A child sitting cross-legged on the grass a little way off, seen from Pip's low viewpoint so she seems large and gentle. Keep her generic and warm.
pages.note: child is a PROP (not a cast member) — see illustration-kit.js PROPS.child.
pages.alt: Pip sees a child sitting cross-legged on the grass a little way off, seen from his low viewpoint so she looks large and gentle.

pages.brief: The child sitting on a bare patch of earth scratching a pattern in the dirt with a stick, absorbed. Pip watching from the railing.
pages.alt: The child sits on a bare patch of earth scratching a pattern in the dirt with a stick, absorbed, while Pip watches from the railing.

pages.brief: Pip hopping down onto the grass — the brave first hop — one foot forward, wings half out, everything about him tentative.
pages.alt: Pip hops down onto the grass — the brave first hop — one foot forward, wings half out, everything about him tentative.

pages.brief: Olive the owl landing heavily on the railing behind Pip, huge by comparison, blocking out a chunk of sky. Comic size contrast.
pages.alt: Olive the owl lands heavily on the railing behind Pip, huge by comparison, blocking out a chunk of sky — comic size contrast.

pages.brief: Olive doing a slow showy turn on the railing with her wings out, half pirouette, entirely pleased with herself. Movement arc.
pages.alt: Olive does a slow showy turn on the railing with her wings out, half a pirouette, entirely pleased with herself.

pages.brief: The child laughing with both birds near her — Pip on her knee, Olive on the railing. Warm, gentle, no touching of the owl.
pages.alt: The child laughs with both birds near her — Pip on her knee, Olive on the railing — warm and gentle, with no touching of the owl.

pages.brief: The two birds flying away over the park treetops together, the child waving small below them. Aerial viewpoint — a wide, distant closing shot by design.
pages.alt: The two birds fly away together over the park treetops, with the child waving small below them, seen from an aerial viewpoint.

pages.brief: Closing page: Pip and Olive back on their own branch in the oak at sunset, the park visible far off. Warm and homeward.
pages.alt: Closing page: Pip and Olive are back on their own branch in the oak at sunset, the park visible far off, warm and homeward.
